title: AP English Language — The Rhetorical Situation
skills: identify the elements of a rhetorical situation
analyze relationships among speaker, audience, purpose, and context
explain how rhetorical situations shape communication choices
apply rhetorical-situation analysis to written and spoken texts
alignment_note: Introduces the rhetorical situation as the interaction among speaker or writer, audience, purpose, message, and context. Supports rhetorical analysis, argument evaluation, audience awareness, and strategic composition across high school English courses, including advanced and AP-level study.
